title: After the Rain: Where Does the Water Go?
topic_key: after rain where water goes runoff infiltration water cycle

age_layers.children: Follow one raindrop through familiar places after a storm.
age_layers.family: Notice how roads, gardens and drains send water in different directions.
age_layers.deeper: Connect runoff and infiltration to the wider water cycle without treating an illustration as a local drainage map.

audience_promise: In one minute, viewers can follow the real paths rainwater can take after a storm, through a gentle illustrated postcard world.
wonder_hook: After the rain stops, where does every drop go next?

growth_plan.hook_line: After the rain stops, where does every drop go next?
growth_plan.retention_promise: Every five-second beat reveals one real path rainwater can take after a storm.
growth_plan.follow_reason: Follow AION for everyday science told through new places and visual worlds.
growth_plan.series_angle: A watercolor postcard is an occasional visual treatment for evidence-backed everyday science, not a replacement for the main series.
growth_plan.editing_rule: Each scene changes the water's location or pathway; no silent filler or repeated scenic shot.

sources.title: Surface Runoff and the Water Cycle

uncertainty_boundary: The exact route and speed of rainwater depend on local soil, slope, vegetation, drainage, and the amount of hard surface; this story explains general water-cycle pathways, not a map of one city.

visual_style.summary: Original hand-painted watercolor and gouache postcard scenes inspired by the quiet atmosphere of Thailand's rainy season; paper texture and gentle pigment are visual language, not evidence.

visual_direction.aion_presence_rationale: AION appears only briefly in a practical black rain jacket with a cyan crystal pin; rain, people, plants and water remain the story.

visual_identity.character: AION is an original silver-white-haired AI guide with cyan eyes and a small cyan crystal pin, translated into a restrained watercolor character only when present.
visual_identity.environment: Original rainy-season Southeast Asian postcard world; never imitate a named artist or show real branded landmarks.
